# UNTITLED CYBER THRILLER - Script Outline

Writer: Alex Novak
Draft: Second Draft
Genre: Cyber Thriller / Drama

## Act 1
- Scene 1-3: Introduce protagonist (Jake), IT security analyst at a mid-size bank
- Scene 4-6: Jake discovers anomalous network activity
- Scene 7: Jake finds the phishing email that started the breach (KEY SCENE - needs realistic prop email on screen)

## Act 2
- Scene 8-12: Jake traces the attack, discovers insider involvement
- Scene 13-15: Confrontation with management who want to cover it up

## Act 3
- Scene 16-18: Jake works with FBI cyber division
- Scene 19-20: Resolution and aftermath

NOTES: Director wants all on-screen computer content to look authentic. Need realistic props for email clients, terminal windows, etc.
